subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly with Air China via Beijing to Harbin for a winter tour of Harbin Ice-Snow World, Sophia Church Square, the Songhua River and the Siberian Tiger Park. A trip to the Yabuli ski resort area takes you on to Mudanjiang and Chateau Volga. Five nights in 5-star hotels (Crowne Plaza Harbin or similar), with two free meal upgrades.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 31–Jan 5 2026 to Jan 28–Feb 2 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Harbin Ice-Snow World: A huge winter park of illuminated ice and snow sculptures, one of Harbin's main attractions.
placeDesc.Yabuli Ski Resort: One of China's largest ski resorts, east of Harbin, with snow scenery and optional skiing.
placeDesc.Chateau Volga: A Russian-style manor park near Harbin with replica buildings, a church and winter activities.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian-style church replica at Volga Manor, popular for photos.
placeDesc.Pushkin Exhibition Hall: An exhibition hall at Volga Manor dedicated to the Russian poet Alexander Pushkin.
placeDesc.Songhua River: The river running through Harbin, a popular promenade that freezes in winter.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park along the Songhua River in Harbin with walkways and old monuments.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's famous pedestrian street of European-style buildings, shops and cafes.
placeDesc.Flood Control Monument: A monument on the Songhua River bank in Harbin commemorating the city's 1957 flood fight.
placeDesc.Sophia Church Square: The square around Harbin's well-known Byzantine-style Saint Sophia Cathedral.
placeDesc.Middle East Railway Bridge: A historic iron railway bridge over the Songhua River built in the early 20th century.
placeDesc.Baroque Old Street: A well-preserved old street of Baroque-style buildings in Harbin.
placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A wildlife park in Harbin focused on Siberian tigers, viewed from a safe vehicle or walkways.
